inputs.controls: One 96-step decision/RNG/acquisition/capacity tape and one acquisition-state body/profile input per case/mirror, reused exactly. No new World RNG or controller calls during replay. Hold geometry, slip, legs and balance evolve physically.

rear.variable: tackler support state at start of last launch interval
rear.rootScope: Confirmed early dive transition; correcting it alone does not repair the long hold.

angled.rootScope: Grip/support feedback. The first angular interval is passive; no reel work. Actual-support substitution sharply reduces path error but is not a universal repair.

proposal.name: held balance follows achieved corrective motion
proposal.falsifiableOracle: Outside the base with frozen outward achieved support u, e_next = rb+(e-rb-u/w)*exp(w*h)+u/w. No bonus from unused free recovery capacity. Unheld parity must remain exact. Halve angled pre-transition errors before a World trial; rear convergence is separately required and currently fails.

ruledOut: Source/input/profile/RNG/extra-controller drift:16 native observer endpoint controls are exact; replay input pins match.
Angular loss as rear cause: rear has zero yaw. Free patch passive and active grips preserve achieved total momentum.
Active reeling as necessary trigger: passive/full-balance cases diverge.
Insufficient grip iterations:32 repeats leave both paths unchanged.
Integrated nonlinear filtered following as primary cause:almost identical position errors.
Pure outcome-label thresholds:continuous support/path and actual hold/fall states diverge before censor/escape labels.

checks.fullGames: Not run; src unchanged and this is a diagnostic task.

limits: Two selected adverse cases,not frequency or NFL realism estimates.
96 steps is a reference,not proved truth.
Full 20 Hz native decisions diverge after physics; the controlled comparison uses the same recorded tape.
No-grip replay explicitly partitions alone bodies using one frozen gait plan.
No-balance disables the continuous update; explicit dive/passive ground lifecycle remains. No-fall ablation is intentionally not a viable upright athlete.
The proposal improves angled refinement but does not fix rear sustained support. No promotion or distributed wrap.
Raw traces stay gzip-compressed in ignored out/. Recreate original collection from417900a for byte-pinned operator; latest runner adds proposal path and extra observer fields only.

mirrorScalarRefinementParity.scope: All twelve isolation variants at all three comparisons, both modes. Every raw mirrored case remains in the canonical manifest.

fractionalTackles.uses: Contact-window speed reduction and help/context diagnostics; not grip force calibration.

recovery.limitations: Walking, averaged and phase-normalized; not football wraps, axial yaw, grip capacity or cleat traction. No recovery timing/rating calibrated.
